periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal, oriented approximately 45 to 60 degrees downward toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-shaped with a vertical-diagonal elongation where the major axis is significantly longer than the minor axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point of the patch extending significantly toward the snout from the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation between ears across the cranial vault, approximately equivalent to the width of the forehead.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded and semicircular apex curvature without visible flattening.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant area of reddish-brown discoloration and possible skin exposure/lesion located in the lower mid-abdominal/umbilical region.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish staining and matting of the fur on the lower ventral surface, contrasting with the white fur on the upper torso.
